method.browser: existing tools/visible-playtest.mjs only; interactive TTY; bounded ordinary input acts and live JPEG inspection
method.restrictions: No source, tests, fixtures, prior reviews, routes, coordinates or hidden state inspected. No edits to implementation. No other browser or server changes.
method.graphics: Established software-WebGL fallback; no hardware performance or audio enjoyment assessment

coverage: Read Mission Brief and How to Play through visible UI
WASD movement, mouse look, ADS, rifle fire, reload, sprint, jump, Soul Shift
Observed phase-break confirmation and critical optic elimination
Recovered East Archive, Heart, West Archive on attempt 2
Returned via yard to green beacon; extraction reached 85% before death
Read all three restored records after death

attempts.notes: Passed opening guard, lost orientation, fired unsuccessfully, attempted receiver recovery under fire. Failure retained.
Opening optic kill; all memories recovered; died during extraction. Failure retained; no win asserted.

strengths.observation: Strong coherent rain-soaked cyan/amber industrial presentation with polished title, briefing, end screen and restored-record archive.
Precise opening optic fire yielded an immediate named critical reward and visible elimination count.
Recovery, supplies restored, objective change, extraction edge warning and uplink percentage communicated progress clearly.

issues.observation: Tall pylon and small receiver require careful distinction; first attempt repeatedly missed receiver approach while taking damage. Brief explains offset, and move-closer prompt helped second attempt.
Close cover repeatedly filled the camera and stopped forward travel; finding return path took correction while exposed. This is observed navigation friction, not a collision defect claim.
Multiple small threat history/charge boxes compete with scene and objective cues; nearest-aim target readout helps, but interpreting threats while turning was demanding.
Controls dialog has dense threat-visor explanation and the Understood button is below captured viewport; driver text click reached it. Scroll interaction was not assessed.

ratingRationale: Playable mission arc with distinctive presentation, clear progression and meaningful optic/phase mechanics; navigation under pressure, HUD density and limited observed combat variety keep readiness provisional.
caveats: Two attempts only, both deaths; victory screen unobserved.
Paused screenshot-driven input is less fluid than continuous human mouse play; low accuracy and route mistakes are reviewer limitations as well as usability evidence.
No frame-rate benchmark, hardware renderer certification, audio assessment, accessibility sweep or settings review.
Ratings are independent provisional whole-game impressions from observed coverage, not perfect or AAA certification.
